stage: the authored documents behind the book

result.shape: a document is not an entity in a JSON array: it is a Markdown file whose YAML front-matter carries the same fields the compiled record has (id, title, format, sourceFile, assetRefs, knowledgeRefs, accessConditions, openEffects), and the module manifest lists that file among its sourceFiles
result.measured: sixty-four authored documents across the module manifests, fifty-eight opening effects, and zero problems: every file exists, every document carries the fields document.schema.json requires, every document declares its OWN sourceFile, every knowledge reference resolves in the project, and every access condition and opening effect uses an operation the engine really executes
result.why_it_matters: three links can fail quietly here - a manifest naming a missing file, front-matter naming someone else's sourceFile, and an unexecuted operation - and each of them would leave a document that cannot be opened or that marks nothing as read
result.basis: the required-field list is parsed from document.schema.json and the executed operations come from the engine sources, so neither can drift from the code they describe
